title: Crash Course - The SMIDSY
summary: A motorcycle safety video on the SMIDSY (sorry mate, I didn't see you) accident, explaining the perception and optical illusion that makes drivers fail to see riders, and how riders can spot the signs and avoid it.
why: HN considers it an outstanding explanation of why drivers miss motorcycles and cyclists, linked in threads on visibility and junction crashes.

quote.text: This is an outstanding vid on the whole subject illustrating the problem and some avoidance methods.
